meta.name: Reach Copy
meta.description: Nine crowns and an unsettled frontier divided by the Greyspine mountains.

meta.style: Quick campaign around one mountain spine

nations.name: Kingdom of Aurel
nations.summary: Rich, populous plains with open borders on every side.

nations.name: Margraviate of Vostmark
nations.summary: Hardy upland march with a martial tradition and poor soil.

nations.name: Serene League
nations.summary: Merchant ports and isles that prefer contracts to battles.
nations.strength: Merchant fleets: trade agreements yield 50% more.

nations.name: Republic of Calder
nations.summary: Scholarly lake republic guarding the Kestrel Pass.

nations.name: Duchy of Istrel
nations.summary: Rugged highlands full of iron and old fortresses.
nations.strength: Mountain engineers: forts cost 25% less and sieges progress 25% faster.

nations.name: Principality of Drevenholt
nations.summary: Populous forest principality with a frontier to the east.

nations.name: Kingdom of Morvaine
nations.summary: Iron-working hill kingdom at the crossroads of the east.

nations.name: Fenward Compact
nations.summary: A small compact of marsh towns, hard to invade and quick to befriend.
nations.strength: Old compacts: +1 envoy and +10 opinion with everyone.

nations.name: Khaganate of Tarsk
nations.summary: Vast steppe khaganate of horsemen with a loosely held periphery.
nations.strength: Horse clans: horse regiments cost 30% less and gain +10% attack.
